title: Page 351
transc:
2  10 am
W. G. Fuller NO  Wash'n May 31st 1865
Emily Norris Brown for Negus care of Mastiff yacht
The Baker Pelham has been ordered to Ginger Tulip
There may be a few days delay in starting
as it is desirable that they should be paid
before starting yardstick I send but Edwards teams and 
Arnold Ambulance teams to each Allen Seward Summer yacht
If you want more sent let me know Madrid


4
J. C Sullivan Nashville  Wash'n May 31st 1865 10 am 
Gertrude Harris for Climax Pork Wabash Kerosene rate of
Howard teams and Hawkins Ambulance teams to Harry vibrate
revolution will go with the Palestine dog more can
be sent afterwards if found rumpus upright Bladder busted


10
Wallack. Ind  Wash'n May 31st 1865 1 PM
Monarch Thirty first Hamit for Governor
Morton His excellency the Blanchard directs
me to say that he has
ordered the sent tenses of Bowles
Milligan & Horsey to be commuted
to imprisonment for life at hard
labor stop He desires you keep
this action secret till day fixed
for the execution By order R Mussey
